metadata.title: Sparse Attention Routing for Long-Context Language Models

authors.name: Aiko Tanaka
authors.affiliation: Graduate School of Information Science, Tohoku University

authors.name: Marcus Feldman
authors.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, ETH Zurich

metadata.abstract: Long-context language models suffer from quadratic attention cost. We propose a routing mechanism that selects a sparse subset of key-value pairs per query head, reducing computation by 6.2x while retaining 98% of dense-attention accuracy on retrieval-heavy benchmarks.
